dedupe_keys.name: high throughput computational screening of nanoporous adsorbents for co 2 capture from natural gas

description: High-throughput computational screening of nanoporous adsorbents for CO 2 capture from natural gas is a dataset listed in Swiss national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Materials Cloud. With the growth of natural gas as an energy source, upgrading CO2-contaminated supplies has become increasingly important. Here we develop a single metric that captures how well an adsorbent performs the separation of CH4 and CO2, and we then use this metric to computationally screen tens of thousands of all-silica zeolites. Coverage: Switzerland. The portal files it under the publisher Materials Cloud. The portal shows 2026-09-23 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support gas network and biomethane studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ch-portal.
